issues.extracted: property tax (General Fund piece 736,361 of 'Property and motor vehicle' 1,033,141)
issues.on_page: p5 General Fund column prints 736,361 on row 'Property and motor vehicle'; p14 General Fund budget schedule prints the same 736,361 as 'Property'
issues.issue: Two printed labels for the same money conflict: the governmental funds statement labels the General Fund amount 'Property and motor vehicle', the budget schedule only 'Property'. A city General Fund normally receives the motor vehicle tax, so 'Property' may be shorthand and the piece may include motor vehicle tax (tax-split standard rule 5: ambiguous amounts stay unlabeled). Arithmetic is exact (736,361 + 136,141 + 160,639 = 1,033,141); the Debt Service piece ('Property taxes', p17) is better supported.
